system.description: This Droid Accessory is a favorite of nobles who want to keep their conversations private. A Droid with an Interference Generator emits a low-frequency sound that interferes with any listening Equipment such as bugs, microphones, or other audio Recording Devices. The deluxe version also interferes with video and holographic Recording Devices. The Interference Generator masks everything in the squares adjacent to the Droid. Anyone Eavesdropping or reviewing recordings of targets protected by an Interference Generator must make a DC 30 Perception or Use Computer check to pick up even scattered words and phrases.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
